notes.title: Startup Crash Fix
notes.notes: A start-up crash for several users has been fixed. Please restart Steam to automatically begin the update if it has not yet been implemented yet.

notes.title: Minor bug updates & optimization
notes.notes: Minor bug updates, added hints, and arrows to show where the doors are in certain rooms

notes.title: Patch minor bugs with journal and certain puzzles
notes.notes: Opening the journal for the first time showed a picture. The journal was accessible during the puzzles on doors. Access to the journal has been removed during puzzle-solving.

notes.title: V1.1.2
notes.notes: Fix the touch controls for the crystal assembly puzzle

notes.title: V.1.1.1b
notes.notes: Minor image correction to QTE. See 1.1.1 for more detail.

notes.title: V1.1.1 (Bug Updates)
notes.notes: Fixed QTE & Door Puzzle bug that crashed the game—additionally, added a hint to the second symbols puzzle upon viewing the hidden symbols location several times.

notes.title: Version 1.1 is now Live!
notes.notes:
